chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Sayyārī, from ʿAlī ibn ʿAbdillāh, who said:
A man asked him about the saying of the Exalted:
Then whoever follows My guidance, he shall not go astray nor be distressed.
He said: The one who affirms the Imams عليهم السلام, follows their command, and does not go beyond their obedience.

key_terms.أَمْرَهُمْ: their command; what they instruct and direct
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: the Imams; the divinely designated leaders to be acknowledged and followed
key_terms.طَاعَتَهُمْ: their obedience; adherence to their rightful authority
key_terms.هُدَايَ: My guidance; the divinely appointed guidance referred to in the verse
key_terms.يَشْقَى: be distressed; fall into wretchedness or misery

ai.seo_question: Who is meant by those who follow Allah’s guidance in Qur'an 20:123 according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the divine guidance in the verse as adherence to the Imams عليهم السلام. It presents safety from misguidance and wretchedness as being tied to affirming their authority and following their command without تجاوز beyond their obedience.
